Alias.name: Gag Chat
Alias.script: --[[Toggling this will determine if the line and follow up prompt are removed from the main buffer for chat.]] GUI.debug("ALIAS", "gag chat matched", matches) GUI.gagChatToggle()

Alias.name: Show Self
Alias.script: --Toggles whether or not you are shown in the group tab. GUI.debug("ALIAS", "show self matched", matches) GUI.showSelfToggle()

Alias.name: Horizontal Scroll
Alias.script: --Toggles horizontal scroll bar on main window GUI.debug("ALIAS", "hscroll matched", matches) GUI.horizontalScrollToggle()
